content.short: Midas provides institutional-grade assets built for the open web.
content.description: Midas unlocks exposure to on-chain, investment-grade securities while delivering the full DeFi toolkit through a permissionless ERC-20 token. It is built to make investing accessible, global, and permissionless, echoing the open Internet ethos. By bringing institutional-grade assets to the open web, Midas enables secure, compliant, and widely available investment opportunities for a broad range of investors. This approach emphasizes security and compliance while keeping opportunities widely accessible.
content.meta: Midas provides exposure to on-chain investment-grade securities and access to DeFi apps via a permissionless ERC-20 token. Discover Midas and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
